messages:
elaine: Quick sync — saw a Dedicated tenant get routed to hosted during a high qps spike. Concern about data isolation guarantees. Anyone else see similar?
marcus: saw it, yes. The spillover policy currently has two modes: hard-isolate (reject) and soft-spill (route). Looks like this tenant is on soft by default.
ravi: Can you paste the request_id? I want to check the trace and which variant it fell back to. We don't currently tag spillover in the per-request logs.
elaine: req=xyz-20260315-09 flagged in console. overflow to hosted-gpt-3.8-8bit.
sara: hmm, contractual tier for that tenant requires "no-hosted" fallback unless emergency. They shouldn't have been on soft.
zack: bug possibility: policy inheritance from org-level -> team-level was flipped during the recent rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout "routing-policy-v2" started by @marcus at 09:02 UTC. :rocket:
marcus: yeah I rolled v2 with "inherit=true" to simplify defaults; didn't realize contract exceptions weren't migrated. My bad.
ravi: Two quick asks: 1) telemetry — we need a "spillover_reason" tag in traces (+variant), e.g. ```{"spillover":{"reason":"capacity","variant":"hosted-gpt-3.8-8bit"}}``` so we can slice by violations. 2) API — should we expose a per-call flag so callers can assert strict isolation?
sara: route_hint could leak internal topology — prefer a boolean param like "allow_spill":true/false at the API layer that still honors tenant contract and logs the reason. That keeps surface small.
elaine: Console UX: add a per-tenant toggle + an audit timeline showing when a request was spilled and to which variant. Product asked for an "audit_trace" link to jump to the raw trace.
zack: ops: I'll run a retrospective query for the last 72h for any tenant with contract.no_hosted=true and a spillover event. If we find hits we need to notify SRE & CS.
marcus: short-term: rollback v2 inheritance. medium-term: migration script for contract flags + telemetry tag + API flag + console indicator.
elaine: action items: @marcus rollback canary, @zack run log query, @ravi spec telemetry + route flag, @sara coordinate product message to affected customers.
marcus: will rollback in 5m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback "routing-policy-v2" completed at 09:12 UTC.
elaine: thanks all — follow up in eng-platform with PRs, queries, and a postmortem note.
